en: Vintage monochrome view of a European street scene titled "Reval Grosse Karri strasse". The image shows a broad cobblestone street lined with multi‑story stone buildings on the left and smaller houses and shops on the right. A tall church spire dominates the background skyline, with additional steeples visible further back. There are a few pedestrians and a horse‑drawn cart on the street. The card has a printed decorative border and appears to be an early 20th‑century postcard photograph.
